text:
maria: Quick huddle thread after launch week. We need to decide what goes into the 72-hour follow-up sprint. Current pool: 9 customer-facing bugs, 10 UX tweaks, 2 backend regressions, 1 infra alert. My suggestion: regressions + infra + blockers in. Then pick top revenue-impact bugs (max 4). Reserve 2 devs for bite-sized UX fixes (<= 4h). Thoughts?
ajay: Sounds reasonable. Quick ask: can we confirm SLA-impacting criteria? e.g., errors > 0.1% or < 99.9% success for payment endpoints.
kelly: Agree on thresholds. Proposed rules: blocker = causes data loss, payment failures, or security. High = customer-reported AND no workaround. Medium = perf/UX pain with workaround. Low = cosmetic.
sam: I'll run the ticket filters and post the shortlisted ids here in 10m. Planning to tag revenue-impact and customer tier.
triage-bot: quick filter done: label:postlaunch status:open severity:high -> 9 hits. Top: #4032, #4046, #4055. Full list on board.
devon: For UX fixes, can we have a UX reviewer sign off on ACs before dev picks? We should avoid rework.
maria: Yes; kelly will be the reviewer. Also, developers should estimate in story points and expected hours.
kelly: Will add short acceptance criteria and required screenshots for each UX ticket moved to the sprint.
ajay: One more constraint: we should keep at least 30% capacity for on-call/incident tasks. If we oversubscribe, rollout risk increases.
maria: noted. We'll cap planned capacity at 70%. Reserve the rest for ops.
sam: shortlist (brief):
#4032 - session token rotation failure (2 reports, enterprise)
#4046 - embed API returns 500 intermittently (5 reports)
#4055 - autocomplete dupes suggestions (8 reports)
#4061 - webhook retries causing duplicates (3 reports)
#4067 - mobile UI overflow on iOS (12 reports, workaround)
#4072 - slow model init on cold start (internal perf)
#4078 - edge-caching misconfig (1 infra alert)
#4089 - regression: chat continuity lost after reconnect (4 reports)
#4093 - payment retry exponential backoff incorrect (prod incident)
devon: I'll volunteer to own #4067 and try to get it done as a 3-4h patch.
kelly: I'll pick up review for #4067 and #4055 ACs.
ajay: I'll coordinate customer comms for #4046 and #4093. Need PM to approve note.
maria: Decision draft: IN to sprint -> regressions (#4032, #4089, #4093), infra (#4078), top revenue bugs (#4046, #4055, #4061, #4072) but mark #4072 as opt-in (depends on perf triage). UX quick wins -> #4067 + two more (<=4h). Others -> backlog grooming.
sam: Can we add quick tests for regressions as part of AC? I can add smoke tests into the pipeline.
maria: Yes - regressions must have automated smoke tests before canary. Add owner and test step to ticket.
ops-bot: scheduled: staging smoke Wed 09:00, canary Thu 16:00. Please flag any conflicts.
ajay: Canary conflicts with a sales demo Thu 15:30-16:30. Can we shift to 17:00?
maria: We should avoid impacting demo. ops-bot, can you propose 17:00 canary?
ops-bot: canary reschedule request recorded. Tentative canary window set to Thu 17:00-18:00.
kelly: I'll update milestones and acceptance criteria tonight. Also adding a short QA checklist for each regression: reproduction steps, expected, smoke test link.
devon: FYI I found a tiny fix pattern for #4055; suspect root cause is index debounce. If it's quick I can push a patch and mark as hotfix.
maria: If it's <=2 hours and has test, do it as hotfix. Otherwise include in sprint.
ajay: Are we documenting rollback criteria for canary? e.g., error rate bump > 0.2% or latency > 2x baseline for 5m -> rollback.
sam: I'll add those thresholds to the deploy runbook.
maria: OK final steps: sam to post final list + owners by EOD (18:00). Kelly to add ACs. Ajay to prepare customer comms drafts for impacted customers. Devon to triage quick fix attempt. Reserve 2 devs for quick UX fixes. We'll run staging smoke Wed and canary Thu 17:00.
ajay: :thumbsup: Will sync with sales.
kelly: :white_check_mark:
devon: On it.
maria: Thanks everyone. If anyone wants to push an item into the sprint, comment on the ticket with impact and effort estimate before 16:30. Otherwise final list goes into the sprint board at 18:00. :sparkles:
